subject.title: Subagent sessions persist after completion, main session becomes unresponsive

question: Should default run-mode subagent sessions be archived or hidden after completion, or should OpenClaw continue retaining them by default and only improve manual cleanup/list filtering?
rationale: The current docs promise auto-archive, but runtime behavior intentionally preserves `cleanup: "keep"` sessions; changing that default affects session history retention and Control UI/session-list semantics.

options.title: Honor documented auto-archive
options.body: Archive completed default run-mode subagents after `archiveAfterMinutes`, keep transcript recovery through the existing archive/delete path, and update tests/docs to match.

options.title: Retain but hide stale children
options.body: Keep completed subagent sessions by default but hide stale rows from normal session lists and make manual cleanup more discoverable.

options.title: Document manual cleanup only
options.body: Leave retention behavior as-is, remove or narrow the auto-archive docs promise, and treat accumulation as operator-managed history.

recommendation.title: Honor documented auto-archive
recommendation.body: Archive completed default run-mode subagents after `archiveAfterMinutes`, keep transcript recovery through the existing archive/delete path, and update tests/docs to match.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans recent subagent lifecycle, Gateway session organization, and product-level retention semantics where steipete has the strongest recent path history.
